data: What is the highest precision value shown in the first graph?

The highest precision value shown in the first graph can be determined by examining the uppermost point of the green line, which represents the 10-fold confidence band. The green line starts at approximately 0.4 on the y-axis (precision) and decreases as it moves to the right (recall). The highest precision value appears to be around 0.4.
